source_versions_and_licenses._why: Recording the version/build and licence basis for every source and service, so a future auditor can establish which source state produced each retained payload and on what basis retaining it is permitted. Where a field is genuinely unavailable it is recorded as unavailable together with the resulting boundary, rather than left blank.

PMID:25855707 / DOI:10.1093/jnci/djv036.version_or_build: Version of record, JNCI volume 107 issue 5. No version or build identifier is issued beyond the DOI, and PubMed exposes no revision stamp for this record, so the 2026-08-03 access date is the retrieval-version boundary.
PMID:25855707 / DOI:10.1093/jnci/djv036.publication_date_note: The two retained payloads disagree and the packet deliberately does not canonize either. PubMed records 2015-04-08 (raw/pubmed-25855707-metadata.json); Scite records 2015-04-02 (raw/scite-doi-lookup-2026-08-03.json). The two services do not label the semantics of their date fields, so which is the online-first date and which the indexing or issue date is NOT resolved here rather than guessed. Both are retained with their source named. DOI:10.1093/jnci/djv036 is the stable identifier and neither date is used as a version boundary for any claim.
PMID:25855707 / DOI:10.1093/jnci/djv036.license_or_terms: CC BY 3.0. The article and its supplementary material are distributed under the Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported licence, as recorded by this repository at backend/data/sources/breast_prs77/NOTICE.md and by the bundled panel's license_basis field ('Mavaddat 2015 article and supplement, CC BY 3.0'). Scite separately reports the record as bronze open access; that flag describes reader access at the publisher and is NOT evidence of the absence of a licence, so the repository's explicit licence record governs.
PMID:25855707 / DOI:10.1093/jnci/djv036.retention_basis: CC BY 3.0 permits reuse with attribution, and the source is attributed by PMID and DOI. Independently of that grant, only bibliographic metadata is retained (identifiers, title, journal, dates, publication types, author names); the publisher abstract and full text are not.

DOI:10.1093/database/bay119.version_or_build: Version of record, Database volume 2018. The packet does NOT assert a publication date for this record: the only retained value is Scite's generic `date` field (2018-01-01), which carries no source-native publication-date semantics - the same limitation the packet records for the JNCI dates. The volume is the version boundary, and the 2026-08-03 access date bounds retrieval.
DOI:10.1093/database/bay119.license_or_terms: CC BY, version not established. Scite reports the record as gold open access with licence `cc-by` and no version field. The publisher's article page at the DOI was fetched on 2026-08-03 to resolve the version: it states CC BY and the copyright line 'The Author(s) 2018. Published by Oxford University Press', but does NOT state a version number. A specific version is therefore deliberately not asserted here.
DOI:10.1093/database/bay119.license_version_note: Review suggested this is CC BY 4.0. That was not confirmed by either retained payload or by the publisher page, so it is not recorded as fact. The DOI is the pointer to the publisher's authoritative terms. Nothing in this packet depends on the version: retention covers bibliographic metadata only, which does not rely on the licence grant.
DOI:10.1093/database/bay119.retention_basis: Only bibliographic metadata is retained and the source is attributed by DOI. CC BY at any version permits reuse with attribution, so the unresolved version does not affect the basis.
unavailable_fields: license_version (not stated by Scite or by the publisher's article page)

Consensus (service).version_or_build: Unavailable. The MCP interface returns no service version, model version, or index build stamp with a search response. The 2026-08-03 access date is the only retrieval-version boundary, so this result is not reproducible against a pinned index state.
Consensus (service).license_or_terms: Consensus terms of service. Provider output is treated as a discovery aid, not as evidence.
Consensus (service).retention_basis: Only the query string, result ranks, and the bibliographic identity of the retained hits are recorded. No generated summary, abstract, or provider narrative is retained, and no Consensus result is cited as support for any claim; every claim rests on the primary records above.

Scite (service).version_or_build: Unavailable. The MCP interface returns no service version or citation-index build stamp. Citation tallies are therefore a point-in-time reading bounded only by the 2026-08-03 access date and will drift.
Scite (service).license_or_terms: Scite terms of service. Provider output is treated as a screening aid, not as evidence.
Scite (service).retention_basis: Only bibliographic fields, the editorial-notice screening outcome, and point-in-time citation counts are recorded. No Smart Citation snippets quoting third-party papers are retained, and no signed access URL is retained. The screening outcome is used to check for retractions, not as support for any scientific claim.

PubMed connector (service).version_or_build: Unavailable as a service version. The retrieved document summary carries no revision stamp for this record, so the 2026-08-03 access date is the retrieval-version boundary.
PubMed connector (service).license_or_terms: NCBI/NLM public data. NLM requires no signed licence for publicly accessible data, subject to source acknowledgement, non-endorsement, and currentness disclosure.
PubMed connector (service).retention_basis: Bibliographic metadata only, attributed to PubMed (NCBI/NLM) with the access date preserved as a fixed historical snapshot. The abstract is removed and author affiliation strings, which carry public contact emails, are not retained.

Ensembl Variation snapshot (backend/data.version_or_build: Unavailable. The snapshot records assembly GRCh38, coord_system chromosome, mapping_policy and checked_on 2026-07-16, but names no Ensembl Variation release or database version - verified by searching it for 'release', 'version' and 'build', none of which appear. The snapshot is therefore re-usable but not re-fetchable-and-confirmable upstream. Tracked by #2246; a release is not invented here.
Ensembl Variation snapshot (backend/data.license_or_terms: Ensembl data is released without restriction (the resource is cited as DOI:10.1093/database/bay119). The stored artifact holds coordinates, alleles and strand for 77 public rsIDs - factual annotation, no third-party expressive content.
Ensembl Variation snapshot (backend/data.retention_basis: Referenced, not duplicated: the canonical artifact lives at backend/data/sources/breast_prs77/ and its SHA-256 is pinned by the panel and re-verified by the packet test.
unavailable_fields: version_or_build (no release identifier recorded in the snapshot)

OUP publisher article page (service).version_or_build: Unavailable. A live publisher page has no version or build identifier; the 2026-08-03 access date is the only boundary, and the page may change.
OUP publisher article page (service).license_or_terms: Publisher-hosted page, all rights reserved. Only the factual outcome of the lookup is recorded; no page content is retained.
OUP publisher article page (service).retention_basis: Nothing is retained beyond the recorded outcome, so no reuse grant is required.

queries.query: 77-SNP polygenic risk score breast cancer risk stratification Mavaddat common genetic variants
queries.result: Rank 1 is the Mavaddat 2015 JNCI paper cited as reference [2], matching its title, first author, year, and journal. The complete 20-result ranking is retained in the payload. No other hit is relied on or characterized: an earlier revision described the rank-4 paper as an independent validation with a different cohort and author group, which the retained partial author lists cannot establish, so that characterization is withdrawn.

Both DOIs resolved. Zero editorial notices on each (no retraction, correction, expression of concern, or erratum) - this is the packet's correction/retraction screening. Verified journal, volume, issue and date for the JNCI record. The page number is NOT verified here: the retained Scite record carries no page field for that DOI. Volume 107 issue 5 and the article number djv036 come from the NCBI record. Also recorded the CC BY gold open-access status of the Ensembl record.

Confirms PMID:25855707 and DOI:10.1093/jnci/djv036 are the same record: 'Prediction of breast cancer risk based on profiling with common genetic variants', Journal of the National Cancer Institute, 2015, volume 107 issue 5, first author Mavaddat, 212 authors. Publication types are Journal Article; Research Support, N.I.H., Extramural; Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't.

queries.original_retrieval: 2026-07-16, recorded as checked_on in the snapshot
queries.endpoint: primary GRCh38 chromosome mapping for the 77 PRS77 loci
queries.result: 77 records (rsid, alleles, location, strand) with assembly_name GRCh38, coord_system chromosome, and a mapping_policy excluding alternate scaffolds. scripts/build_breast_prs77.py re-derives the documented 39/2/41 classification from it.
queries.why_not_copied_into_this_packet: The snapshot is already checked in as the artifact the build script consumes, and the panel pins this exact SHA-256 in model_provenance.reproducibility.checked_in_snapshot_sha256. Duplicating it under raw/ would create a second copy that can silently drift from the one that actually drives the build. The packet references the canonical artifact and its digest instead, and the packet test recomputes that digest so a mismatch fails.

queries.purpose: Resolve whether the publisher states a CC BY version for the Ensembl Variation paper.
queries.result: The page states CC BY and the copyright line 'The Author(s) 2018. Published by Oxford University Press'. It does NOT state a version number. This is a negative result and it is what the packet relies on to record the licence version as not established rather than asserting CC BY 4.0.
queries.no_payload_retained: Only this outcome is recorded. The page is publisher-hosted all-rights-reserved chrome around a CC BY article; retaining a scrape of it would add third-party expressive content the packet does not need. The DOI is the stable pointer to the publisher's authoritative terms.

panel_derived_values.note: The locus counts in cancer.md come from the bundled panel, not from either paper.
panel_derived_values.source: backend/data/panels/cancer_prs_weights.json -> model_provenance.current_allele_audit on the weight set whose trait is breast_cancer. Identified by trait, not by position: the loader treats weight_sets order as insignificant.
panel_derived_values.guard: tests/backend/test_cancer_prs_docs_consistency.py derives the expected counts from the panel and cross-checks runtime_blocked_loci == multiallelic + biallelic.

audit_reproducibility.generator: scripts/build_breast_prs77.py deterministically re-derives the forward / reverse-complement / palindromic classification from that snapshot.
audit_reproducibility.integrity_pin: the breast_cancer weight set's model_provenance.reproducibility.checked_in_snapshot_sha256 pins the snapshot's SHA-256, so editing it breaks a recorded hash.
audit_reproducibility.what_is_reproducible: The documented 39 / 2 / 41 counts can be re-derived offline from repository contents.
audit_reproducibility.what_is_not: The Ensembl Variation RELEASE identifier is not recorded anywhere in the snapshot - verified by searching it for 'release', 'version' and 'build' tokens, none of which appear. The snapshot can therefore be re-used but not re-fetched and confirmed upstream, because the database state that produced it is unnamed.
audit_reproducibility.not_invented: A release identifier is deliberately not supplied here; a fabricated version would read as verified.
audit_reproducibility.tracked_by: #2246 - narrowed to recording the Ensembl Variation release identifier.
